project:
We are building a Progressive Web App (PWA) called HanVoice.
Mission:
Help complete beginners become comfortable speaking conversational Korean.
Our primary philosophy is reducing speaking anxiety through:
- tiny conversational chunks - pronunciation-first learning - immersive AI conversations - immediate feedback - minimal cognitive overload
This is not a grammar-heavy course.
Instead we teach useful phrases that people can immediately use in real life.
Example:
❌ "Today we learn present tense."
Instead:
✅ "Water please." ✅ "Thank you." ✅ "Excuse me." ✅ "One coffee please."
target_users:
Primary users:
- Complete beginners - K-drama and K-pop fans - Tourists - Expats - People who understand Korean but are afraid to speak
Success metric:
The user should confidently speak to a Korean person within their first week.
platform:

- React - TypeScript - TailwindCSS - Mobile-first - Progressive Web App
Backend

Database

architecture_principles:
The application should be:
- modular - testable - API-first - component-driven - highly maintainable
Avoid premature complexity.
Choose simplicity unless complexity provides clear long-term benefits.
ai_architecture:

Outputs include:
- accuracy - fluency - completeness
Conversation Engine

↓

↓

current_task:
Only complete the tasks below.
Do not attempt to build the full application.
Task 1
Design a PostgreSQL database schema suitable for Supabase.
The schema must support:
- users - authentication integration - daily API usage - token limits - pronunciation attempts - handwriting attempts - AI conversation history - scenario progress - lesson progress - subscriptions - waitlist - founder pass purchases
Explain why each table exists.
Task 2
Create a production-quality system prompt for the first conversation scenario:
Ordering an iced Americano inside a Seoul café.
The AI should behave like a polite Korean barista.
The AI should:
- always remain in character - speak naturally - use beginner-friendly Korean - gently correct context mistakes - never produce grammar explanations unless requested
The model must always return valid JSON using exactly this schema:
{ "ai_response_hangul": "", "ai_response_romanized": "", "ai_response_english": "", "contextual_correction": "" }
No additional keys.
No Markdown.
No commentary.
Only valid JSON.
